panel.title: Instance backup
panel.intro: One encrypted file with everything that makes this instance itself: roles and policies, environments and their agent tokens, workflows, schedules, the secrets vault, plugin settings, and the certificate authority your agents trust.
panel.twoBackups: This is not a container backup. Container data is backed up separately under Storage; you need both.
panel.keyWarning: The key is never stored. Keep it somewhere other than this host: an export whose only key is on the machine it backs up cannot be restored when that machine is lost.

status.title: Last restore
status.restarting: McHarbor is restarting to load the restored keys and data. This page reconnects on its own.
status.reconciling: Reinstalling the export's plugins at their recorded versions.
status.anchor: Audit history was restored; the chain continues through a restore anchor.
status.pluginsFailed_one: {{count}} plugin could not be reinstalled. Install it from the Plugin Store.
status.pluginsFailed_other: {{count}} plugins could not be reinstalled. Install them from the Plugin Store.

empty.title: No exports yet
empty.description: Create the first export and store it, with its key, away from this host.

create.title: Create an instance export
create.description: The export is encrypted as a whole. Choose how it is locked; you will need the same passphrase or key file to restore it.
create.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters. It is stretched with Argon2id and never stored.
create.keyFileReady: A key file was generated. Save it now: it is shown once and cannot be recovered.
create.keyFileSaved: I have saved the key file somewhere other than this host
create.metricsHelp: Off by default: metrics regenerate on their own and usually make up most of an export's size.
create.notePlaceholder: For example: before upgrading to the next release

reasons.key_required: Enter a passphrase or generate a key file.
reasons.key_both: Use a passphrase or a key file, not both.
reasons.passphrase_too_short: The passphrase must be at least 12 characters.
reasons.key_file_invalid: That is not a McHarbor instance key file.
reasons.note_too_long: The note can be at most 500 characters.
reasons.busy: An export is already running. Wait for it to finish.

download.title: Download instance export
download.description: This file holds every secret in the instance. Confirm it is you before downloading.
download.totpHint: Use the code from your authenticator app if your account has one.
download.warning: Store the file encrypted and away from this host. Anyone with the file and its key owns this instance.

delete.title: Delete this export?
delete.description: The file {{name}} is removed from this host. Copies you downloaded are not affected.

restore.title: Restore an instance export
restore.description: Choose the export and its key. The whole file is checked before anything is changed.
restore.planDescription: This is what the restore changes. Nothing has been written yet.

full.label: Everything (disaster recovery)
full.description: Replaces this instance with the export: data, keys, certificate authority and files.

migration.label: Everything, onto new hardware or another database
migration.description: The same as a full restore, for moving an instance.

selective.label: Only some categories
selective.description: Recover, for example, deleted workflows or a damaged role set, and leave the rest alone.

conflicts.replace: Replace the whole category with the export's
conflicts.keep: Keep them and add only what is missing

restore.includeAuditHelp: Replaces the audit log with the export's. The chain continues through a restore anchor that records what was replaced.
restore.auditApproval: Restoring audit history needs instance_backup.restore_audit through an approved elevation request, at the time you restore.

reasons.key_required: Enter the passphrase or choose the key file.
reasons.key_both: Use a passphrase or a key file, not both.
reasons.wrong_key: That passphrase or key file does not open this export.
reasons.not_export: This file is not a McHarbor instance export.
reasons.format: This export was made by a newer McHarbor and cannot be read here. Upgrade first, then restore.
reasons.incomplete: The export is incomplete: it ends before everything it lists. Copy it again from the source.
reasons.damaged: The export is damaged or was altered after it was made.
reasons.key_kind: This export was sealed with the other kind of secret. Use its passphrase or key file instead.
reasons.bad_key_file: That key file is not a readable McHarbor instance key file.
reasons.bad_conflict: Choose how to treat rows that already exist.
reasons.approval_required: Restoring audit history needs an approved elevation for instance_backup.restore_audit. Request one under Security, then try again.

plan.from: Export from {{host}}, McHarbor {{version}} on {{backend}}, taken {{date}} by {{user}}.
plan.restoresKeys: The instance encryption key is replaced with the export's.
plan.restoresSecret: The audit signing secret is replaced with the export's.
plan.restoresFiles: The certificate authority, stack files and custom nodes are replaced; remote agents keep trusting the restored authority.
plan.plugins_one: {{count}} plugin is reinstalled at its recorded version after the restart.
plan.plugins_other: {{count}} plugins are reinstalled at their recorded versions after the restart.
plan.restart: McHarbor restarts when the restore is written.

refusals.newer_schema: This export comes from a newer McHarbor. Upgrade this instance first.
refusals.key_pinned: ENCRYPTION_KEY is set in this server's environment, so the export's key cannot take its place. Remove it or set it to the export's key, then restart.
refusals.secret_pinned: MCHARBOR_SECRET is set in this server's environment, so the export's audit secret cannot take its place.
refusals.nothing_selected: Nothing would be restored. Choose at least one category.
refusals.postgres_cascade: On PostgreSQL without superuser rights a selective replace would cascade into other categories. Choose to keep existing rows instead.

warnings.different_key: This export was made on an instance with a different key. Encrypted values are converted to this instance's key as they are restored.
warnings.metrics_excluded: Metrics history is not in this export and starts again from empty.

verify.title: Verify this export
verify.description: The export is restored into a throwaway database and checked: every table against its manifest, and the audit chain. This instance is not touched.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.empty: No scheduled exports. An export made only by hand is an export made too rarely.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.deleteDescription: {{name}} stops running. Exports it already made are kept.
schedules.dialogDescription: Exports run unattended, so their key is stored on this instance, encrypted. Keep the same key somewhere else too, or the exports cannot be restored after losing this host.
schedules.replaceKey: Replace the key (leave empty to keep it)
schedules.keyHint: A passphrase of at least 12 characters, or a key file you generated.
schedules.verifyAfter: Rehearse a restore after each export

reasons.bad_name: Give the schedule a name of at most 100 characters.
reasons.bad_retention: Keep between 0 and 1000 exports, for at most 3650 days.
reasons.no_retention: Set how many exports to keep, or for how many days.
reasons.key_required: Enter a passphrase or choose a key file.
reasons.key_both: Use a passphrase or a key file, not both.
reasons.passphrase_too_short: The passphrase must be at least 12 characters.
reasons.key_file_invalid: That is not a McHarbor instance key file.
